# Verification

Actor, observation time (UTC), project revision, toolkit revision, environment,
approved scope and evidence classification: UNRESOLVED.

| Command / method | Exit code | Actual observation | Result | Artifact / SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| UNEXECUTED | — | No observation | NOT_ASSESSED | — |

Include applicable syntax/lint, unit/integration, security and build/schema checks.
Record unavailable checks as BLOCKED/NOT_ASSESSED with the reason. Keep source
review distinct from live behavior, and preserve failed runs with their disposition.

Link findings, owner decisions and rollback steps in the project's tracking system.
